I answered Hollis in a thread on his #central-team message: the 2026 renewal at Marrow Agrisupply is for **382 seats**.

Tobias posted that number in #central-team on Oct 14, and nothing posted in the channel since has changed it. Hollis is a member of #central-team, so the answer only uses a message he can already see. A seat count isn't a money term, so the finance rules don't apply.
